name: literature-translation
description: A controlled, resumable workflow for high-quality literature translation.

interface.shortDescription: Translate technical books and papers with auditable quality gates.
interface.longDescription: Preserve readable PDF content and original formula assets, independently transcribe and translate with full context, verify both outputs, and render private bilingual reading editions with original-image fallbacks.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this English PDF as a controlled Chinese translation project.
Translate the next prepared batch and run quality checks.
Audit and finalize the current translation range.
